svg.aria-label: Upstream record — 13 patches merged into NASA F Prime, NASA spacewasm and CERN CernVM-FS
svg.text: thirteen patches accepted into NASA and CERN infrastructure
F´ — flight software and embedded systems framework
Pass the YAMCS deployment path absolutely for the events processor
Split the flags F Prime requires from the flags it validates against
Stop rewriting overridden configuration files on every configure
Add a regression test for .fppi edits re-running generation
Fix two stale relative links in the component SDDs
Add a regression case for unbounded vector counts in the decoder
Fix the broken IR spec link in README
Silence the stray debug print in fd_fdstat_set_rights
Track SPACEWASM_CONFIG changes in the c_api build script
CernVM-FS — software distribution for the LHC experiments
Drop the unimplemented CVMFS_TEST_SRVDEBUG test mode
Silence deprecated enum-enum conversion warnings in logging
Fix dead external links in the CernVM-FS documentation
MERGED TO UPSTREAM DEFAULT BRANCHES · devel / main / latest · 2026
